page_title: EMP 1-1 FIO | Empoli v Fiorentina 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Pairetto no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
87' Substitution. Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) in, Liberato Cacace out.
84' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
82' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
81' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Flag goes up against M'Baye Niang (Empoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) replacing Youssef Maleh.
78' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) replaces Cristiano Biraghi.
73' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
72' Here is a change. Andrea Belotti is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Riccardo Sottil cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Luca Pairetto didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
69' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Luca Pairetto blows for a foul after Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
66' The game is interrupted. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
65' It looks like Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Luca Pairetto won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
62' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Alfred Duncan will be replaced by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch for Davide Faraoni.
61' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! M'Baye Niang (Empoli) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Pietro Terracciano.
56' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) is going to take the penalty!
56' It’s a PENALTY to Empoli after the VAR review!
56' Referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Empoli. Let’s see what happens!
56' One of the Empoli players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
54' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
53' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) tested Pietro Terracciano with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alberto Cerri comes off for Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Davide Nicola gives a chance to M'Baye Niang (Empoli) and Emmanuel Gyasi is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Luca Pairetto has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli).
45+4' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
45+2' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Luca Pairetto interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post.
42' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
40' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
39' Luca Pairetto couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) and blew his whistle.
30' Davide Nicola is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alberto Grassi suffers an injury and Razvan Marin (Empoli) comes on.

30' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Rolando Mandragora, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
29' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:0.
26' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' The game is interrupted as Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is flagged offside.
22' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' The players claim that Alberto Cerri (Empoli) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
15' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
13' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
4' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. One of the players from Empoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' The game is interrupted now, Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
2' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
1' The match has just started.
Empoli will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Pairetto.
